attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `hxpB`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names it in 100% of calls with 0.08 bits. Then columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 16% of calls.

**The first fork is at `yniB`**, carried by 88%, with `ydjM` at 12%. The model names genes in 64 to 99.6% of calls across these columns, and it is most hesitant at column 7, `thrS`, at 1.19 bits, named in 64%. A parallel branch of 31 families runs through columns 4 to 34, carried by 11 to 12%, all persistent, from `cedA` to `gdhA`, [[chitin disaccharide catabolism]] among them.

**A second branch of 6 families** runs through columns 35 to 40, carried by 10 to 11%, all persistent, `topB` to `pncA`. Columns 41 to 48 are variable, carried by 82%, all persistent, `ydiH` to `ldtE`, [[Fe-S cluster assembly]]. A third branch of 22 families runs through columns 49 to 70, carried by 10%, all persistent, `yeaC` to `yeaG`.

**The model names genes readily on the persistent spine**, 98% of calls at 0.15 bits, and hesitates on the cloud, 14% named at 4.34 bits. Inside a region of plasticity it names 61% of calls at 1.74 bits, against 97% at 0.18 bits outside. The window ends at column 79, `ydhL`, carried by 72%.

label: hxpB
facts:
WINDOW: the hxpB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor hxpB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,012 to 2,091 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying hxpB once); 42,880 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.28 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,994 calls, named 98%, 0.15 bits; shell 4,594 calls, named 69%, 1.11 bits; cloud 292 calls, named 14%, 4.34 bits. Outside an RGP 40,172 calls, named 97%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 2,708 calls, named 61%, 1.74 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 63 fork, 16 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.74 against 0.18 bits) and names fewer genes (61% against 97%); 2,708 of the 42,880 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 7 (thrS) 1.19 bits, RGP 2%; column 30 (ydiP) 0.63 bits, RGP 7%; column 25 (fadK) 0.58 bits, RGP 6%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-16%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: hxpB. named 100%; 0.08 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-16%. named 64-99.6% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 7, named 64%, 1.19 bits.
   a second branch of 31 families through columns 4-34, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-12%, all P; the branch's families: cedA, katE, chbG, celF, chbR, chbA, chbC, chbB, osmE, nadE, cho, ves, spy, astE, astB, astD, astA, astC, xthA, ydjX, ydjY, ydjZ, ynjA, ynjB, ynjC, ynjD, ynjE, ynjF, nudG, ynjH, gdhA

   a second branch of 22 families through columns 49-70, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10%, all P; the branch's families: yeaC, msrB, gapA, yeaD, yeaE, mipA, yeaG, yeaH, cdgI, dgcJ, yeaK, yoaI, yeaL, nimR, nimT, yeaO, yoaF, dgcP, yoaK, yoaJ, yeaQ, yoaG
